stem: Which sentence best highlights that the author is impressed with the creation of the Great Pyramid?

options.label: F
options.text: Many people have wondered how the ancient Egyptians could have built such a massive structure.

options.label: G
options.text: Fortunately one man, the archaeologist Zahi Hawass, made it his life's goal to restore the Great Pyramid and the smaller pyramids that surround it.

options.label: H
options.text: In fact, the structure has lost about 30 feet of its original height.

options.label: J
options.text: Historians have learned that the pyramid's builders were farmers.
